meta.title: Control: ezmode
meta.purpose: Control intent for testing the design discovery workshop's steps against the operator's hand-made ezmode service design. Composed by not-hotdog from a summary the operator adopted.

what_it_is: Ezmode is tools for game modders: players running heavy mod setups, the mod authors they depend on, and the community leaders who hold their groups together. It is one ecosystem of four products (a crash reporter, community pages for gaming groups, mod hosting that pays creators, and a desktop mod manager). It matters because these communities keep being displaced, their crash fixes get lost, and their creators aren't paid fairly.

real.text: Today players like Alex crash with no idea why, and can't tell whether it is just them or whether a fix exists.
Today mod authors like Sarah get 'my game crashed idk' in chat instead of real data, and are paid fractions of a penny if at all.
Today a diagnosis worked out in chat never reaches the next player with the same crash.

These communities have lost their home several times: their files were locked by the big mod host in 2021, their community platform died under corporate ownership in 2025, and their chat platform demanded government IDs in 2026.

direction.becoming: One ecosystem where each product works alone and gets better connected, built on promises that are the reverse of what these communities lived.

proposals.text: Each product works alone and gets better connected.
A crash someone has already worked out reaches the next player who hits it.
Creators are paid fairly and keep control of their work, including deleting it.
Only content that is actually illegal is removed, and leaving is real; that is what makes staying meaningful.
